name: Kryzect
summary: A founder-led technology company focused on software engineering, AI, and automation built around business objectives. Its published services span web and mobile apps, SaaS, APIs, cloud, data, e-commerce, integrations, and custom software.

services.title: Web & Software
services.description: Websites, web applications, and software built around your users and objectives.

services.title: Mobile Apps
services.description: iOS, Android, and cross-platform mobile products built around how real users actually work.

services.title: AI Solutions
services.description: AI applications, assistants, agents, and integrations chosen because they solve a real problem — not because they are fashionable.

services.title: Automation
services.description: Workflow, API, and process automation that turns repetitive work into systems that run on their own.

services.title: SaaS & Digital Products
services.description: SaaS products and digital products taken from idea to something people can actually use.

services.title: API & Backend
services.description: APIs and backend systems built to be reliable, secure, and understandable — explained in plain language.

services.title: Cloud Solutions
services.description: Deployment, hosting, and cloud infrastructure that keep your software running — without unnecessary complexity.

services.title: Data & Analytics
services.description: Data processing, analytics, reporting, and pipelines that turn raw data into decisions you can act on.

services.title: Custom Dashboards
services.description: Admin, analytics, and operational dashboards that put the right information where your team needs it.

services.title: E-commerce
services.description: Online stores, custom storefronts, checkout, payments, orders, and inventory — built to sell and to run smoothly.

services.title: Custom Software
services.description: Internal systems, business tools, and custom platforms built around the way your organization actually works.

services.title: Integrations
services.description: Integrations that connect your existing systems — without replacing the tools you already use.

pricing: No fixed public pricing. Projects vary based on scope and objectives; a quote requires a discussion.
audience: Works with small businesses, startups, and individuals where the project is a good fit, including international clients. A technical specification is not required to begin a discovery conversation.
existingSystems: Can work with existing systems depending on the technology and situation; integrations connect existing tools rather than requiring their replacement.
team: Currently founder-led by Muhammad Ali Aamir, with a network of collaborators and plans to grow the engineering team. No verified headcount or client count is published.

product.name: IncidentIQ
product.summary: AI-powered incident postmortem drafting from raw incident data, with specialized agents, grounded analysis, and mandatory recorded human approval before finalization.
product.roadmap: Usage-based API monetization, SaaS multi-tenancy, enterprise features, and Slack/PagerDuty/GitHub/Jira integrations are roadmap items, not claims of shipped capabilities.
